import json, os, time
iterations, forks = 16, 128
pid = os.getpid()
group, session = os.getpgid(pid), os.getsid(pid)
began = time.monotonic_ns()
for i in range(iterations):
    assert os.getpgid(pid) == group
    assert os.getsid(pid) == session
lookups = (time.monotonic_ns() - began) / 1e6
reader, writer = os.pipe()
helper = os.fork()
if helper == 0:
    os.close(writer)
    assert os.read(reader, 1) == b''
    os._exit(0)
os.close(reader)
try:
    began = time.monotonic_ns()
    for i in range(iterations):
        assert os.getpgid(helper) == group
        assert os.getsid(helper) == session
    descendant = (time.monotonic_ns() - began) / 1e6
finally:
    os.close(writer)
    waited, status = os.waitpid(helper, 0)
    assert waited == helper and status == 0
began = time.monotonic_ns()
for i in range(forks):
    child = os.fork()
    if child == 0:
        assert os.getpid() != pid and os.getppid() == pid
        assert os.getpgid(0) == group and os.getsid(0) == session
        os.execl('/bin/true', 'true')
    waited, status = os.waitpid(child, 0)
    assert waited == child and os.WIFEXITED(status) and os.WEXITSTATUS(status) == 0
result = dict(lookups_ms=lookups, descendant_lookups_ms=descendant,
              fork_exec_wait_ms=(time.monotonic_ns() - began) / 1e6)
with open('/var/tmp/process-identity-result.json', 'w') as file:
    json.dump(result, file)
print('PROCESS_IDENTITY_OK', flush=True)

selection_basis: The interleaved eight-run fork/exec/wait comparison has lower compact median latency and page faults with equal median Job CPU. Both complete installation runs and all correctness checks pass. Full-install wall time and CPU were worse in the compact observation under heavier foreign activity; they are not presented as an installation speedup.
limitations: The complete-install start conditions differ: the compact 300-second quiet attempt failed and its original unused root was then measured under observed load. The compact run saw compilers in every sample and foreign runtime workers in 11 samples. Host sampling can miss short-lived activity. Selected-route native cold diagnostic timing overlapped release compilation and is not used for the selection comparison.
